title: From Concepts to Components: Concept-Agnostic Attention Module Discovery in Transformers
reasoning: The paper focuses on an interpretability method (SAMD) to discover attention heads associated with arbitrary concepts. While it uses 'safety' as one of its test domains and evaluates jailbreaking using the HarmBench dataset, the core of the work is a technical interpretability mechanism rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religious, moral, or ethical systems themselves.
